piece.headline: Bhavik takes the throne as IB crumbles
piece.standfirst: Bhavik's Bench Boost and a Fernandes armband put him top by 1 point, while IB drops from first to 19th.
piece.big_picture: Bhavik leads by a point from Ahmad after the week's best score. IB led last week and now sits 19th. Cherag is third, and the top 3 are packed tight. Nobody up there can relax.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Sasha backed Thiago over Haaland: 4 with the armband against 26. A lone punt that missed.
piece.one_to_watch: Bhavik leads Ahmad by 1 point. One captain pick next week could flip the top spot.

winners.name: Bhavik
winners.verdict: Bench Boost, the week's best captain pick and the league lead. Nerve and timing, and it all came off.

winners.name: Nanik
winners.verdict: Backed Fernandes as captain and climbed 8 places. Calm, sensible and well rewarded. Gold spots are in sight.

winners.name: Ahmad
winners.verdict: Fernandes in the armband lifted him to 2nd. But 15 points sat on the bench, so there was more in the tank.

losers.name: Sasha
losers.verdict: Sasha was the only one to captain Thiago, who returned 4. A bold punt that missed. Next week is a fresh page.

losers.name: Iain
losers.verdict: Iain went solo on Cunha, who returned 18. The captain call was fair. The week still didn't go his way.

losers.name: IB
losers.verdict: IB lost top spot and is now 19th. Isak in the armband gave 16. A brutal fall.
